title: An interrupted migration copy is detected, never auto-completed, and resumes

pins.section: ## 12. Migration: M1 project → M2 project copy

steps.action: startup scan of the data root

expect.entry: project with an interrupted migration destination
expect.reason: the migration marker suppresses the §8.3 default-envelope completion

steps.action: write the v2 envelope last and remove the marker

durableEffects: the destination becomes loadable only once its v2 envelope exists; the marker is removed last
observations: an operator may instead delete the partial destination directory (it has never been authoritative for anything)
the source project is never opened for writing, never released and never claimed by the migration

notes: Packet-15 acceptance: interrupted migration-copy creation has a deterministic completion rule and preserves the original byte-for-byte.
